description: This Java class 'ModifyThingLiveCommandImpl' is an immutable implementation of the 'ModifyThingLiveCommand' interface that encapsulates a command for modifying a 'Thing' in the context of Eclipse Ditto's signal commands. It provides methods to access the contained 'Thing', set headers, and create answer builders, and is part of the 'modify' subpackage related to live modifications of Thing entities.

classes.name: ModifyThingLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable class implementing 'ModifyThingLiveCommand' to handle live modification commands for a 'Thing' in Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of 'ModifyThingLiveCommandImpl' from a generic 'Command<?>', cast to 'ModifyThing'.

methods.name: getThing
methods.description: Returns the 'Thing' object associated with this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is 'MODIFY'.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers for the command, returning a new instance with updated headers.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command changes authorization; returns false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Creates a new builder for the command's answer.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the command instance.
